Class SocialNetworkGraph

java.lang.Object
SocialNetworkGraph
public class SocialNetworkGraph extends Object
SocialNetworkGraph represents a social network using a graph data structure. It allows adding and removing people, establishing friendships, suggesting friends, finding shortest paths, and counting clusters.
